buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1006200253 Note: Only Designer recommended source are eligible to participate in tender. 1.(a)Item is to be Supplied by the vendor as per documents(with latest amendments wherever applicable) (b)The required input material /Raw material is under vendor scope. The required test set-up for assembly & testing is in vendor's scope. (c) Acceptance tests: Acceptance is to be done as per documents. (d) Free Issue of Material (FIM): No FIMs will be given. 2.(a)Inspection agency: MSQAA or their nominated agency. (b)All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports of the items cleared by t he inspection agency. (c) Final acceptance after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with I-Note/Green Card of MSQAA or thei r nominated inspection agency. 3. Vendor shall inform BDL and MSQAA at various stages as per QA matrix prior One Week to review/witne ss and give clearance for further processing. 4. All documents /drawings supplied along with this tender are the property of DRDO and 100% IPR is held with DRDO. These documents/drawings shall not be used for any other purpose, not to be disclosed, copie d and revised in any form without the permission of RCI (DRDO). 5. Delivery Terms: The items shall be delivered at BDL stores and free delivery to BDL (For BDL Kanchanb agh, Hyderabad). 6. Warranty period: The items supplied must bear warranty for 1 year from the date of acceptance at BDL. Warranty certificate should accompany with supplies. 7. Delivery schedule: within 2 months from date of placement of MSQAA Vetted PO. Early deliveries are ac ceptable. Terms & conditions 1. Payment terms: 90% payment with 100 % taxes and duties will be made within 30 days after receipt an d acceptance of material at BDL on pro rata basis. Balance 10% payment against submission of 5% PBG wi th validity till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. BDL reserves its right to release GST only after suppliers invoice / debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST L aw. 2. Security deposit: Security deposit shall be submitted by the successful bidders for 5% of the order value (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from scheduled banks) with in one week from the date of purchase order and valid up to successful execution of the order till the last d elivery date as per purchase order plus 3 months claim period. SD will be released after successful comple tion of the order and against submission of performance bank guarantee as applicable.

3. Non-Disclosure Agreement: Vendor has to enter in to a Non-Disclosure Agreement as per the format pro vided by BDL. 4. Liquidated damages: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon accordi ng to the delivery schedule given in the PO. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, wi thin the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inc luding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part the reof, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 5. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offers by con ducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors to equal level play ing field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender without e-reverse auction , i f required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the discretion of BDL. The details of auct ioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarization will be arranged for the same, if required . 6. The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no subj ect alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order. 7. Purchase Preference (PP) Clause (Make in India): order 2017 is applicable details can be submitted with the bids. 8. "HSN Code: Vendor has to provide HSN code (six digit code) for the items". 9. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 10. All other general terms and conditions as per BDL limited tender terms and conditions. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.
